usageNotes: Use this endpoint to audit or display the ordered firewall ruleset for a specific QEMU VM on a PDM-managed PVE remote. The caller must hold the Resource.Audit privilege on the remote/VM path. If the VM lives on a specific cluster node, pass the optional `node` parameter to route the request directly; omitting it lets PDM auto-resolve but may fail if the VM is not found cluster-wide.

examples.summary: List all firewall rules for VM 101 on remote 'pve-hetzner'

tips: Rules are returned in positional order (pos field); the first matching rule wins at enforcement time.
A rule with enable=0 is defined but inactive — it still appears in this list.
The action field may be a security group name rather than ACCEPT/DROP/REJECT when the rule references a group.
This reflects the VM-level ruleset only; datacenter-level and cluster-level rules are evaluated separately.
